connectorUiConfig.title: Cloudflare (Using Blob Container) (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Cloudflare data connector provides the capability to ingest Cloudflare logs into Microsoft Sentinel using Cloudflare Logpush and Azure Blob Storage. Refer to [Cloudflare documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/about/) for more information. The storage account can be in a different subscription or resource group from the Microsoft Sentinel workspace when the deploying user has the required permissions on those resources.

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Subscription permissions
customs.description: Contributor permissions are required on the target resource group to deploy storage queues and Event Grid resources. Owner or User Access Administrator permissions are required on the storage account when creating the Event Grid sender role assignment. The Microsoft.EventGrid resource provider must be registered in the storage account subscription.

customs.name: Microsoft Sentinel collector permissions
customs.description: Before connecting, grant the Microsoft Sentinel first-party enterprise application displayed below Storage Blob Data Reader and Storage Queue Data Contributor on the storage account. These permissions allow the collector to read Cloudflare blobs and process notification and dead-letter queue messages. The generated template does not create these collector role assignments.

customs.name: Event Grid delivery identity
customs.description: The connector enables a system-assigned managed identity on the Event Grid system topic and uses it to deliver BlobCreated events to the notification queue. Choose Create to grant that identity Storage Queue Data Message Sender on the storage account. Choose Use existing only when the same topic identity already has that account-scoped role.

customs.name: Create a storage account and a container
customs.description: Before setting up logpush in Cloudflare, first create a storage account and a container in Microsoft Azure. Use [this guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/storage-blobs-introduction) to know more about Container and Blob. Follow the steps in the [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-account-create?tabs=azure-portal) to create an Azure Storage account.

customs.name: Generate a Blob SAS URL
customs.description: Create and Write permissions are required. Refer the [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/document-translation/how-to-guides/create-sas-tokens?tabs=Containers) to know more about Blob SAS token and url.

customs.name: Collecting logs from Cloudflare to your Blob container
customs.description: Follow the steps in the [documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/get-started/enable-destinations/azure/) for collecting logs from Cloudflare to your Blob container.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Cloudflare Logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
To enable Cloudflare logs for Microsoft Sentinel, provide the required information below and click on Connect.
>

parameters.label: The Blob container's URL you want to collect data from
parameters.name: blobContainerUri

parameters.title: Event Grid Storage Queue Data Message Sender assignment
parameters.name: eventGridRbacMode

options.label: Create the required storage-account role assignment
Use an existing storage-account role assignment

parameters.content: Choose **Create** for a new Event Grid topic, a newly enabled system-assigned identity, or when the topic identity does not yet have **Storage Queue Data Message Sender** on the storage account. Choose **Use existing** only when that exact topic identity already has the role. If authorization initially fails, wait up to ten minutes for RBAC propagation and retry with the same values.

parameters.label: The Blob container's storage account resource group name
parameters.name: StorageAccountResourceGroupName

parameters.label: The Blob container's storage account location
parameters.name: StorageAccountLocation

parameters.label: The Blob container's storage account subscription id
parameters.name: StorageAccountSubscription

parameters.label: The event grid topic name of the blob container's storage account if exist. else keep empty.
parameters.description:
The data flow using event grid to send 'blob-created event' notifications. There could be only one event grid topic for each storage account.
Go to your blob container's storage account and look in the 'Events' section. If you already have a topic, please provide it's name. Else, keep the text box empty.
parameters.name: EGSystemTopicName
